text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a weird spike where some tenants show negative invoice line items after the compact aggregation pass last night. Anyone else seeing this?

maya: yep, saw the same in the preview dashboard around 00:12 UTC. some previews show -$0.00 and a negative token delta :confused:

sam_k: digging now. quick hypothesis: compact-agg finalizer merges overlapping windows then applies dedupe, but reattributes from route-fallback rewrite are being applied afterwards, so we end up with a + and a - for same logical usage.

jordan: can you dump a raw event pair? need tenant ID + event fingerprints to confirm.

sam_k: paste of one pair below (sanitized):
```
{ "tenant": "t-42", "event": "usage", "tokens": 120, "agg_window": "2026-03-10T12:00Z-13:00Z", "route": "primary", "fingerprint": "fp-abc" }
{ "tenant": "t-42", "event": "usage", "tokens": -120, "agg_window": "2026-03-10T12:00Z-13:00Z", "route": "fallback", "fingerprint": "fp-abc" }
```

sam_k: notice both have same fingerprint but different attribution; finalizer applies positive then later reattribute job emits a compensating negative. our dedupe key is currently `fingerprint||window_start` which doesn't distinguish attribution version.

lee: so the root cause is attribution churn after finalization. two approaches: make dedupe key stable across reattributes, or prevent reattributes post-finalizer. which is less risky?

maya: short-term mitigation: pause compact-agg finalizer for the last 3 hourly windows to avoid producing any final invoice previews until we patch.

metering-bot: action logged — feature-flag "compact_agg_finalizer" set to OFF for canary and prod-last3 windows by maya at 4278001302.

alex: good. can we also add an alert to console for negative invoice deltas so support can catch this earlier? something like `preview_delta < 0` for X tenants in 5m. I can own the alert config.

jordan: tagging billing-team: @billing-team — some previews may have shown negative credits to customers. recommend we pause any automated invoice emails until we reconcile.

billing-team: acknowledged. we'll pause scheduled invoice notifications for affected customers and coordinate a customer-facing note if needed.

sam_k: working on hotfix branch `fix/dedupe-stable-key` — plan: include `attribution_version` in dedupe id and make reattribute job increment that version. also adding a guard in finalizer that ignores events with attribution_state != stable.

lee: long-term let's add `original_route_trace` to event envelope so we can trace attribution flips. also emit a metric `invoice_preview_negative_delta_count` and wire it to ops alerting.

maya: tests for the branch are running. CI shows one flaky test related to event replay ordering; fixing now.

alex: can we get a dry-run reconciliation to list affected tenants? sam_k, can you run and paste results here?

sam_k: running: `python tools/reconcile.py --mode dry-run --since 2026-03-10T00:00Z --window-hours 48`

metering-bot: dry-run complete — 12 tenants flagged with negative preview deltas. sample tenants: t-42, t-109, t-7. Full CSV uploaded to shared drive: https://redwood.internal/flags/compact-agg-anomalies.csv

jordan: I'll create a short runbook for support: how to identify affected previews, how to mark invoices as "pending reconciliation" in the console.

maya: canary will go out in ~10m to staging with the dedupe fix. if green, roll to prod holdback windows next hour.

alex: thanks all — really appreciate the quick response. will follow up with a postmortem even if this resolves cleanly.

maya: adding postmortem placeholder: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/compact-agg-attribution-race

sam_k: (reminder) after fix: run controlled backfill to recompute previews and send corrected deltas to billing pipeline with idempotency token.

lee: nit: we should also add a unit test that simulates attribution flip + finalizer ordering to prevent regressions.

alex: +1. if anyone hits anything else, drop here. :thumbsup:
